name: Tractor Beam

features.name: Beam 'Em Up
features.description: Leaves only high symbols and wilds.

features.name: Clone Attack
features.description: One animal returns in huge stacks.

review:
Farm meets UFO on 5x3. Beam 'Em Up randomly beams away the non-organic symbols, leaving only high symbols and wilds, and Clone Attack beams back one farm animal in huge stacks.

Three or more scatters give 7, 9 or 12 Abduction Spins. Silly and fun. High volatility, a 3,408x max and a 32% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
